author: Play On Tabletop
description:
Gundam Assemble is finally here! https://global.bandai-hobby.net/en-us/site/gundam-assemble/ We play the brand new Starter Set and had an incredible time. JT and Tak, are both long time fans of the Gundam universe and are excited to show you what this new game is all about.

This video is sponsored by Gundam Assemble! @gundam-assemble  How cool is that? Play On Tabletop was invited on stage at the Las Vegas Open in early October to help present the upcoming Deluxe Set and got to bring home a Starter Set. 

Bandai Tabletop Games. The platform centralizes event discovery, registration for official tournaments, and match record tracking, and provides organizer support tools.  https://www.bandai-tabletop-games.com/
